description: Source file implementing the DrmPlugin class for ClearKey DRM, handling session management, license provisioning, secure stops, and event notifications within the Android DRM framework.

classes.name: DrmPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of DRM plugin handling session management, license requests, secure stops, and event notifications for ClearKey DRM.

methods.name: initProperties
methods.description: Initializes plugin properties and device info.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM session given its session ID.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt data for a session (not implemented).

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Attempts to encrypt data for a session (not implemented).

methods.name: getHdcpLevels
methods.description: Retrieves HDCP levels (not used in this implementation).

methods.name: getKeyRequest
methods.description: Generates a key request for license acquisition.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves DRM log messages (not implemented).

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Provides DRM metrics such as session counts.

methods.name: getNumberOfSessions
methods.description: Returns current and maximum number of open sessions.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseKeySetIds
methods.description: Lists stored offline license key set IDs.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of an offline license.

methods.name: getPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Gets a byte array property value.

methods.name: getPropertyString
methods.description: Gets a string property value.

methods.name: getProvisionRequest
methods.description: Requests provisioning data (not supported).

methods.name: getSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves a secure stop object by ID.

methods.name: getSecureStopIds
methods.description: Lists all secure stop IDs.

methods.name: getSecureStops
methods.description: Lists all secure stops.

methods.name: getSecurityLevel
methods.description: Gets security level for a session.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified security level.

methods.name: provideKeyResponse
methods.description: Provides a key response to complete license acquisition.

methods.name: provideProvisionResponse
methods.description: Handles provisioning response (not supported).

methods.name: queryKeyStatus
methods.description: Queries key status for a session.

methods.name: releaseAllSecureStops
methods.description: Removes all secure stops.

methods.name: releaseSecureStop
methods.description: Removes a specific secure stop.

methods.name: releaseSecureStops
methods.description: Removes multiple secure stops based on opaque data.

methods.name: removeAllSecureStops
methods.description: Clears all secure stops.

methods.name: removeKeys
methods.description: Removes keys for a session (not implemented).

methods.name: removeOfflineLicense
methods.description: Deletes an offline license by key set ID.

methods.name: removeSecureStop
methods.description: Removes a secure stop by ID.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder is required (not used).

methods.name: restoreKeys
methods.description: Restores offline keys into a session.

methods.description: Sends expiration update event.

methods.name: sendKeysChange
methods.description: Sends key change event.

methods.name: sendSessionLostState
methods.description: Notifies session lost state.

methods.name: setPlaybackId
